reviews.text: Very good salon
They really took good care of my cat and I left extremely satisfied. A big thank you to the lady and the young man for their professionalism.
Jonathan was meticulous and super patient. He didn't hesitate to take breaks so that my cat would be more relaxed.
Jonathan did a wonderful job lion cut on my dovey. He always does !
Good grooming experience for a dog who is usually stressed

I was worried about my 5-month-old puppy's first grooming session. She's a bit anxious and still being socialized, but Jonathan was very attentive and immediately reassured me. He was patient, gentle, and caring with her, and it went very well. Excellent service and a beautiful result.

Jonathan is absolutely amazing! My dog Sadie, isn’t the easiest dog to groom, but he is always so patient, kind, and gentle with her. You can really tell he cares about the dogs he works with, and it shows in the quality of his grooming. Sadie always comes home looking beautiful, and I know she’s in great hands. I highly recommend Jonathan to anyone looking for a groomer who truly goes above and beyond! 😊

Jonathan is the best. I've been going to him for years and I'm so grateful to have found someone who does such a good job and is also extremely caring and careful with my pets. Every experience has been amazing, he leaves my dogs and my cat looking super cute every time. He has a ton of experience and it shows in every facet of his work. I wouldn't go to anyone else. Top notch!
I trust no one  else but Jonathan to do my Shiba's nail trimming. He's patient and gentil and experienced. I recommend his services anytime.

I’ve been bringing my dogs here for over 13 years. It used to be a grooming school, but the ownership recently changed. The new owners have been wonderful. They are attentive, kind, and caring.

I have a Havanese with anxiety, and this is the only grooming salon where he feels comfortable. They continue to be incredibly patient with him. They also did a fantastic job grooming my Giant Schnauzer.

I’m so grateful that I can continue bringing my dogs to the same place with people I trust. I highly recommend them!

We have complete confidence and peace of mind when we drop off our Golden Retriever and Belgium Sheppard at La Pagaille.
We have been clients for four years and take the time to travel across town from NDG for their excellent services.
They are patient and take the time to understand the characters of the dogs. They do fantastic work and the dogs look ready for a competition when we pick them up.
Copper and Enzo give Johnathon four paws up!

Saturday was my first visit to your store. I love your service, even Fluffy! You are very professional. Thank you, Jonathan and Joanne!
Mireille❤️
Friendly staff, reasonable prices, and they treat my anxious poodle very well.
Great personalized service - My anxious dog Lester was very calm ans wont have any issues going back regularly

My Chihuahua gets very stressed when it comes to grooming, so finding the right groomer has always been important to me. Jonathan and Johanne treat him with incredible patience, kindness, and understanding.
They genuinely care about the animals and take the time to make them feel safe and comfortable.
Another thing I truly appreciate is the transparency of this salon. Through the front window, you can actually see how the dogs are being treated. Nothing is hidden behind walls or closed doors, which gives me great peace of mind.
It's rare to find a place where both the pets and their owners feel so comfortable. I highly recommend this salon to anyone looking for a groomer they can trust.
I called to make an appointment for my cat. The man who answered was unprofessional and rude; he curtly replied, "We're fully booked," and hung up. I certainly won't be calling that number again.

I've been getting my dog ​​groomed here for over four years, three to four times a year. I've always been very satisfied, both with the service and the price. My dog ​​is a rescue; she doesn't like loud noises or being separated from me for too long. They reassure her and are gentle with her!

Here's my little darling after her appointment 😌
Excellent service and beautiful grooming for my Nordic dog who is very difficult and doesn't like it. We had a great time. 10/10 recommended.

Jonathan has such positive energy! My dog ​​is usually very anxious when he has to go to the groomer, but Jonathan completely changed the experience for him. Thanks to his patience, gentleness, and instinctive way of calming my dog, he was relaxed and happy. Thank you so much, Jonathan, we'll be back to see you soon!

I have a six year old Yorkie Poo, Benji, who is very anxious by nature.  Jonathan is the BEST groomer I have ever had.  We have been going to him for the last two year, and wouldn't use anyone else.  With Jonathan, Benji is actually excited about "bath time"....the nails, not so much lol, but Jonathan is so very patient with him.  You can trust Jonathan to take the best care of your baby,  He truly cares and it shows.

Jonathan is an excellent master, a very welcoming atmosphere, professional at his job and very good quality trimming. I recommend to the owners of Westies to visit, the price will pleasantly surprise you.

Absolutely outstanding service! Our dog came back looking gorgeous and clearly so happy! The care, attention to detail, and kindness from the staff really show. Highly recommend this grooming salon! A large vitrine lets you watch your beloved dog being pampered, which is such a comforting touch. She came out looking absolutely stylish and happy—couldn’t be more pleased with the experience! Thank you, Jonathan, you are the best groomer in town! Highly recommended!!!
The staff were super kind and really took their time with my dog. He came back looking amazing and not stressed at all like at some other places. I’ll definitely will be coming back!
Johnathan did a fantastic job. He was very gentle and patient with my Molly. Thank you. We will definitely be back. Great service!

Welcome back Johanne! Milla has a fantastic haircut!
You're the best ❤️❤️

Hello, I would like to have more info on the courses to leran how to groom. Ive tried contacting by phone multiple times but the phone number doesnt seem to work. Does anyone know how else can i comunicate with them? Thank you

Top-rated grooming salon
Easy access
Very kind and attentive staff
Café across the street if you need to wait for your pet
The best place for everyone. Beautiful work, always impeccable, and at a really great price.

Johanne, the owner, and her colleague were amazing in washing and caring for my little white cat, Javel, who had her tail almost torn off by another cat. We definitely took her to the vet, and she's doing much better. The city sent an investigator to warn the owner of the aggressive cat. She tore off half of Javel's face in the spring. The total vet bill was $750.
Amazing, I've been going to them for almost an year. Julie is great, she takes care good care of my puppies.
Our go to grooming location 😊 …
Julie's service is always quick and friendly! I highly recommend her.
Johan didn’t really take her time to cut equally the hair of my cat. She just wanted to finish her work. I will never go back
